scientific_integrity: Complete proof and independent finite arithmetic checks are supplied. Random-order local maxima/recolouring reduction is credited to the cited motivating paper; neither that reduction nor general peak means are claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniform distinct vertex labels on balanced complete bipartite graphs with a deleted matching, not arbitrary perturbations, uneven shores or nonuniform orders. The total-variation estimate is asymptotic; independent proof audit has not been performed. Indexed historical searches cannot certify absolute priority.
title: Affine peak laws and the one-sixth transition under bipartite matching deletion
